statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of paroxysmal palpitations and episodic lightheadedness
The patient has concern for recurrent supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation
The patient has a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The service billed is CPT code 93226 (48-hour Holter monitoring study)
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific diagnostic procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to assess for arrhythmic burden and guide anticoagulation therapy
